description.value: Bowl'd is a Korean-inspired poke bowl restaurant that opened in Revelstoke in 2023, built around fresh, carefully sourced ingredients and bold flavour combinations including Korean spicy pork, BBQ beef, and chicken teriyaki. The business rebranded from its previous identity as The Nomad Food Co. and has positioned itself as a go-to spot for nutritious, satisfying bowls in town. A touring cyclist would find it a solid option for a filling, flavourful meal on the main commercial strip.
